data.purpose: Machine and platform authority: Grass/ISA/X86, Grass/ABI/Win64, Grass/Platform/Win32. Encoding tables, external authority citation (DECISIONS 15 dual-cited Intel/AMD intersection), and API contracts (DECISIONS 16 Win32 x64 baseline).

data.note: Machine and platform authority, the owner coord1:43 proposed for ISA/X86, ABI/Win64 and Platform/Win32; registration was deferred there until the bus contention work landed, which it now has. DECISIONS 15 (dual-cited Intel/AMD intersection) and 16 (Win32 x64 baseline) govern this slice. Four differential oracles and one physical-probe campaign live in the exclusive Tools entries; they are mine because each is meaningless apart from the corpus it checks. Three shared claims are repo-level gates this slice both depends on and has hardened: Tools/AxiomAudit.lean now rejects @[implemented_by]/@[extern] and audits private declarations, Tools/DocstringAudit.py resolves named theorems against Tools/DeclNames.lean (new, shared) rather than trusting backticks, and library.yml carries the x86 differentials plus a Windows ml64 job. g-foundation:39 already holds AxiomAudit and library.yml as shared, so this is a second shared holder rather than a contested claim. Outside this slice entirely, three one-sentence docstring corrections were made in other owners' trees when the strengthened DocstringAudit began flagging them: Grass/Std/Logical/Vec.lean, Grass/Obligation/Delta.lean and Grass/Memory/Substep.lean. Each names an enforcing declaration where the prose named none; none changes any proof. They are disclosed here rather than claimed, and their owners should overrule me freely.
